_comment: MINIMAL, generic architectural node map for lib/dep_boundaries.py. Replace nodes/paths with the real repo's own (each node's package prefixes are DERIVED by scanning 'package X' at run time and are left in the payload as derived_prefixes, for reference only). A full example instantiated over a critical-flow domain lives in config/examples/critical-flow/dep-boundaries.json.
node_dir_note: If a node declares a folder that is an ancestor of another node's (e.g. the app module root as a catch-all), the more specific (longer) folder prefix always wins: a file is never counted twice.
